verses.t: Kale Mulungu anayankhula nthawi zambiri ndi m'njira zosiyanasiyana kwa makolo athu mwa aneneri.
Koma tsopano m'masiku otsirira ananena kwa ife mwa Mwana wake. Mulungu analonjeza Mwana wake chilichonse ngati cholowa, ndipo mwa Mwana analenga chilengedwe chonse.

Mwana ndi chionetsero cha ulemerero wa Mulungu ndi chifanizo cha umunthu wake weniweni, nasunga chilengedwe chonse mwa mawu amphamvu ake. Atatiyeretsa ku machimo athu, anakhala ku dzanja lamanja la Mulungu wa ulemerero kumwamba.
Ichi chikusonyeza kuti Mwana ali wamkulu koposa angelo, monga mmene dzina lake ndi lapamwamba koposa awo.
Pakuti Mulungu sanauze angelo mwa iwo kuti, 'Iwe ndiwe Mwana wanga. Lero ndakhala Atate wako.' Ndipo sanati, 'Ndidzakhala Atate wake, ndipo iye adzakhala Mwana wanga.'
Ndipo Mulungu anabweretsa Mwana wake woyamba m'dziko lapansi, anati, 'Angelo onse a Mulungu ampembedze.'
Pa angelo anati, 'Amawatumiza angelo ake ngati mphepo, atumiki ake ngati malawi a moto.'
Koma pa Mwana anati, 'Mpando wako wa ufumu, Mulungu, ukhalapo nthawi yonse. Ulamulira ndi ndodo ya kulungama.
Ukonda kulungama nanaukira zoyipa. Choncho, Mulungu, Mulungu wako, anakuozera mafuta a chimwemwe koposa anzako.'
Ndipo anati, 'Kuyambira pachiyambi, Ambuye, unaika maziko a dziko lapansi ndipo unapanga kumwamba ndi manjaako.
Iwo adzawonongeka, koma iwe ukhalapo nthawi yonse. Adzauka ngati zovala zakale.
Udzazikokotera ngati chovala nakuchotsa. Koma iwe ndiwe wokhalabe; moyo wako sutha.'
Ndipo Mulungu sanauze angelo mwa iwo kuti, 'Khala ku dzanja langa lamanja mpaka ndiike adani ako pansi pa mapazi ako.'
Choncho, angelo ndi mizimu yokha yotumizidwa kutumikira iwo amene adzalandira chipulumutso.
Choncho tiyenera kusamalira bwino choonadi chimene tanamva, kuti tisamize.
Pakuti uthenga umene Mulungu anapereka mwa angelo unali wolimba, ndipo kulakwitsa malamulo awo kapena kusamvera kunalangidwa.
Choncho titha kupulumuka bwanji ngati sitifundike chipulumutso chachikulu kotere? Chinalalikidwa poyamba ndi Ambuye Yesu mwini, kenaka anapereka kwa ife ndi iwo amene anamva.
Ndipo Mulungu anatsimikizira uthenga wake ndi zizindikiro, zodabwitsa, ndi zozizwitsa zosiyanasiyana, ndi mphatso za Mzimu Woyera pa chifuniro chake.
Pakuti Mulungu sanaikira angelo ufumu wa dziko limene tikunena.
Pakuti Malemba anena m'malo mwina kuti, 'Kodi anthu ndi chiyani kuti uwasamalire, kapena mwana wa munthu kuti umsamalire?
Unawaika pang'ono pansi pa angelo, nawaika tauzo la ulemerero ndi ulemu.
Unaika zonse pansi pa ulamuliro wawo.' Posanena kuti 'zonse,' tikusonyeza kuti palibe chimene sichiika pansi pa ulamuliro wawo. Koma tsopano sitinaone zonse ziika pansi pa ulamuliro wa anthu.

Koma tinaona Yesu, amene anaika pang'ono pansi pa angelo, tsopano avala tauzo la ulemerero ndi ulemu chifukwa cha imfa imene anamwalira. Inde, mwa chisomo cha Mulungu, Yesu anayumva imfa chifukwa cha aliyense.

Mulungu, amene zinthu zonse zinachitikira iye ndi mwa iye, anasankha kubweretsa ana ambiri ku ulemerero. Ndipo kunali koyenera kuti mwa masautso apange Yesu, mtsogoleri wa chipulumutso chawo, kukhala wangwiro.
Choncho tsopano Yesu ndi iwo amene ayeretsa ali ndi Atate mmodzi. Chifukwa chake Yesu saopa kuwatchula abale ndi alongo.
Pakuti anati kwa Mulungu, 'Ndidzaululira dzina lako kwa abale ndi alongo anga. Ndidzakutamanda pakati pa mpingo.'
Ndipo anati, 'Ndidzakhulupirira mwa iye,' ndipo, 'Ine ndi ana amene Mulungu anandipatsa.'
Chifukwa ana a Mulungu ndi anthu a thupi ndi mwazi, Mwana nalinso analowa m'moyo wa anthu. Pakuti mwa imfa basi angathe kugwetsa mphamvu ya Satana, amene anali ndi mphamvu ya imfa.
Mwanjira imeneyi anafutula onse amene anali akapolo nthawi yawo yonse chifukwa cha mantha a imfa.
Tidziwanso kuti Mwana sanabwera kuthandiza angelo; anabwera kuthandiza mbadwa za Abulahamu.

Choncho zinali zofunika kuti afanane ndi ife m'chilichonse, abale ndi alongo ake, kuti akhale Wansembe Wamkulu wachifundo ndi wokhulupirika pamaso pa Mulungu, kupanga nsembe yokhululukira machimo a anthu.
Chifukwa iye mwini anazunzika ndipo anayesedwa, atha kutithandiza tikayesedwa.
Choncho, akuze ndi alongo oyera amene muli ogawana ndi kutchedwa kumwamba, ganizani bwino za Yesu, mtumwi ndi Wansembe Wamkulu wa chikhulupiriro chathu.
Pakuti anali wokhulupirika kwa Mulungu amene anamukhazikitsa, monga mmene Mose anali wokhulupirika pa nyumba yake yonse.
Koma Yesu ayenerera ulemerero wamphamvu koposa Mose, monga mmene wamanga nyumba ayenerera ulemerero wamphamvu koposa nyumba yomweyo.
Pakuti nyumba iliyonse imamangidwa ndi wina, ndipo walenga chilichonse ndi Mulungu.
Mose anali wokhulupirika pa nyumba ya Mulungu yonse monga mtumiki. Ntchito yake inali chifanizo cha choonadi chimene Mulungu adzaululire pambuyo.
Koma Khristu, ngati Mwana, ndi woyang'anira nyumba ya Mulungu yonse. Ndipo ife ndife nyumba yake, ngati tikakhala olimba mu chikhulupiriro chathu ndi kukhazikika pa chiyembekezo chathu.
Ndiko chifukwa Mzimu Woyera akuti, 'Lero mutamva mawu ake,
musaume mitima yanu monga Israeli anachita pa kukaniza, tsiku la mayeso m'chipululu.
Kumeneko makolo anu anandiyesa ndipo anandipima, ngakhale anaona zochita zanga kwa zaka makumi anayi.
Choncho ndinaukira, ndipo ndinati, 'Mitima yawo ikuchoka ku ine nthawi yonse. Sakuchita zimene ndikuuza.'
Motero m'mkwiyo wanga ndinalonjeza kuti sadzalowa m'mpumulo wanga.'
Samalani, akuze ndi alongo. Onani kuti palibe aliyense mwa inu ali ndi mtima woipa wa kusakhulupirira, umene umutembenuse kuchoka kwa Mulungu wamoyo.
Mukumbutsane tsiku ndi tsiku, pamene tsiku la 'lero' linalipo, kuti aliyense mwa inu asapusitsidwe ndi tchimo ndi kuuma mtima.
Pakuti takhala ogawana ndi Khristu ngati tikakhala okhulupirika mpaka mapeto, monga mmene tinali pachiyambi.
Kumbukirani zimene zinanena kuti, 'Lero mutamva mawu ake, musaume mitima yanu monga Israeli anachita pa kukaniza.'
Ndipo ndani anakana? Kodi si iwo amene Mose anawatolera ku Misiri?
Ndipo Mulungu anaukira ndani kwa zaka makumi anayi? Kodi si iwo amene anachimwa, amene matupi awo anagona m'chipululu?
Ndipo Mulungu anauzirani ndani kuti sadzalowa m'mpumulo wake? Kodi si iwo amene sanamvere?
Choncho timaona kuti chifukwa cha kusakhulupirira kwawo sanakwanitsike kulowa m'mpumulo wake.
Lonjezo la kulowa m'mpumulo wa Mulungu linalipo. Choncho tiwopere, kuti wina mwa inu asamize.
Pakuti tinalalikidwa Uthenga Wabwino monga iwo nawo. Koma sitinawathandize, pakuti sanaphatanize uthenga ndi chikhulupiriro.

Pakuti ife amene takhulupirira tidzalowa m'mpumulo. Mulungu anati pa iwo, 'M'mkwiyo wanga ndinalonjeza kuti sadzalowa m'mpumulo wanga,' ngakhale mpumulo unali wokonzedwa kuyambira pochita maziko a dziko.
Tidziwa ichi chifukwa Malemba anena pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri kuti, 'Pa tsiku lachisanu ndi chiwiri Mulungu analewekezera ntchito yake yonse.'
Ndipo m'malo mwina Mulungu anati, 'Sadzalowa m'mpumulo wanga.'
Choncho mpumulo wa Mulungu uli, ndipo anthu ena adzalowa, koma iwo amene oyamba kulalikidwa Uthenga Wabwino sanalowepo chifukwa cha kusamvera.
Choncho Mulungu anasankha nthawi yina, ati 'Lero,' monga anauza Davide nthawi yambiri pambuyo, monga tinalembadi, 'Lero mutamva mawu ake, musaume mitima yanu.'
Ngati Yoswa anawapatsa mpumulo, Mulungu sananenere nthawi ina.
Choncho pali mpumulo wapadera wosungidwa kwa anthu a Mulungu.
Pakuti aliyense amene alowa m'mpumulo wa Mulungu amaleka ntchito yake, monga mmene Mulungu analeka ntchito yake.
Choncho tiyesetse kulowa m'mpumulo umenewo. Koma ngati tisamvera Mulungu monga Israeli anachita, tidzagwa.

Pakuti Mawu a Mulungu ali ndi moyo ndi mphamvu. Ndi achangu koposa lupanga laliwiri mivi ndi mivi, ndi achisawawa mpaka pakugawa mzimu ndi moyo, nsonga ndi munofu wa mafupa. Maganizo ndi zolinga za mtima zimawulutsidwa.
Palibe chilichonse chobisika pamaso pa Mulungu. Chilichonse chaululiridwa ndi kufotokozedwa pamaso pa iye amene tidzapereka naye nkhani yathu.
Choncho, popeza tili ndi Wansembe Wamkulu wamkulu amene analowa kumwamba, Yesu Mwana wa Mulungu, timangirire chikhulupiriro chathu.
Wansembe Wamkulu wathu atha kutitonthoza pa uchifookezo wathu, chifukwa anayesedwa m'chilichonse monga ife, koma sanachimwe.
Choncho tipite mwachilimbikitso ku mpando wa chisomo wa Mulungu wathu. Tizalandira chifundo ndi kupeza chisomo kutithandiza pa nthawi yosowa.
Wansembe Wamkulu aliyense ndi munthu wosankhidwa kuyimira anthu pamaso pa Mulungu. Apereka mphatso ndi nsembe chifukwa cha machimo awo.
Atha kuchitira chifundo iwo amene sadziwa ndi otsoka chifukwa iye mwini amavutika ndi uchifookezo.
Choncho amaperekanso nsembe chifukwa cha machimo ake mwini.
Ndipo palibe amene adziyerekeze yekha kukhalira ulemu wa Wansembe Wamkulu. Amayenera kutchedwa ndi Mulungu, monga mmene Aroni anatchedwa.
Chimomwecho Khristu sanadzikuze yekha kukhalira Wansembe Wamkulu. Mulungu ndiye anamupatsa ulemu umenewu, anati, 'Iwe ndiwe Mwana wanga. Lero ndakhala Atate wako.'
Ndipo m'malo mwina anati, 'Iwe ndi wansembe nthawi yonse monga Melkizedeki.'
Yesu ali padziko lapansi, anapemphera ndi kulomba ndi kulira kwakukulu ndi misozi kwa Mulungu amene angathe kumupulumutsa ku imfa. Ndipo Mulungu anamvera chifukwa cha ulemu wake.
Ngakhale anali Mwana wa Mulungu, anaphunzira kumvera mwa zinthu zimene anazunzika nazo.
Mwanjira imeneyi, Mulungu anamupanga kukhala Wansembe Wamkulu wangwiro, ndipo anakhala gwero la chipulumutso chosatha kwa onse amene anamvera.
Ndipo Mulungu anamuika kukhala Wansembe Wamkulu monga Melkizedeki.
Pali zambiri zimene tingauze pa ichi, koma zovuta kufotokoza, makamaka popeza muli osatamva.

Ndipo pakali muyenera kuphunzitsa anthu ena. M'malo mwake, mukufunikira kuti wina akuphunzitseni kena mfundo zoyamba za Mawu a Mulungu. Ndinu ngati ana amwetama amene amafunikira mkaka, osati chakudya cholimba.
Pakuti amene amadya mkaka basi ndi ana amwetama osazindikira chilichonse pa kulungama.
Koma chakudya cholimba ndi cha okhwima, amene mwa kuzolowera anaphunzira kuzindikira chabwino ndi choipa.
Choncho tizisiye maphunziro oyamba a Khristu ndi kupita kutsogolo ku kukhwima. Sitibwerere kena kuzika maziko a kutembenuka mtima ku ntchito zofa ndi chikhulupiriro mwa Mulungu.
Sitifunikira phunziro lina pa ubatizo, kutayika manja, kuuka kwa akufa, ndi chiweruzo chosatha.
Ndipo tidzapita kutsogolo, ngati Mulungu atalola.
Pakuti sikotheka kubwezeretsa ku kutembenuka mtima iwo amene anachilolewa kale, amene anayumva zabwino za kumwamba ndi kugawana ndi Mzimu Woyera,
amene anayumvitsa kukoma kwa Mawu a Mulungu ndi mphamvu za nthawi yobwera,
ndipo natembenuka kuchoka kwa Mulungu. Sikotheka kuwabwezera ku kutembenuka mtima; pakuti iwo ngati amkangalidwanso Mwana wa Mulungu ndi kumvetsa manyazi pamaso pa onse.
Nthaka imene imamwa mvula ndi kubereka zipatso zothandiza iwo amene aimasalira, imalandira mdalitso wa Mulungu.
Koma ngati ibesereka miiba ndi udzu, ndi yopanda pake. Mlimi adzaitsutse ndipo adzaiphya.
Abwenzi okondedwa, ngakhale tikunena motero, tikukhulupirira za inu kuti muli ndi mbali yabwino koposa, zochokera ku chipulumutso.
Pakuti Mulungu si wosalungama kuti awale ntchito yanu ndi chikondi chimene munamuonetsa mwa kutumikira anthu oyera, monga mmene mukuchitabe.
Chifuniro chathu ndi kuti aliyense mwa inu aonetse chidukulu chomwecho mpaka mapeto, kuti chiyembekezo chanu chitsimikiziridwe.
Choncho musakhale odzimata, koma mutsate chitsanzo cha iwo amene mwa chikhulupiriro ndi kupirira adzalandira zimene Mulungu walonjeza.
Chitsanzo ndi lonjezo la Mulungu kwa Abulahamu. Popeza palibe wamkulu wina wolumbira naye, Mulungu analumbira m'dzina lake mwini, nanena,
'Ndidzakudalitsa ndithu ndi kuchulukitsa mbadwa zako.'
Abulahamu anapirira, nalandira zimene Mulungu analonjeza.
Anthu amalumbira m'dzina la wamkulu kuposa iwo, ndipo lumbiro limasindikizira zonse ndipo likakamiza.
Chifukwa chake Mulungu nalumbiriraso kuti osankhidwa kulandira lonjezo adziwe mwatsimikizika kuti iye sadzasintha maganizo ake.
Choncho Mulungu anapatsa zinthu ziwiri zosinthika, chifukwa Mulungu safikira kunama. Choncho ife tathawira kwa iye tili ndi chilimbikitso chachikulu pa chiyembekezo chimene chikhalapo pamaso pathu.
Chiyembekezo ichi ndi ngati nanga yolimba ndi yokhulupirika ya moyo wathu. Chimatsogolera mpaka m'malo opatulika a Mulungu m'temberero.
Yesu wandikapo kale kwa ife. Wakhala Wansembe Wamkulu wosatha monga Melkizedeki.
Melkizedeki uyu anali mfumu ya mzinda wa Salemu ndipo anali wansembe wa Mulungu Wamkulu. Abulahamu atalimbana ndi mafumu nabwera, Melkizedeki anamukumana ndi kumdalitsa.

Ndipo Abulahamu anapereka gawo la khumi la chilichonse chimene anagwira m'nkhondo kwa Melkizedeki. Dzina Melkizedeki litanthauza 'mfumu ya kulungama,' ndipo mfumu ya Salemu litanthauza 'mfumu ya mtendere.'
Mulibe mbiri ya abambo ake kapena amayi ake kapena mzera wa makolo ake, palibe chiyambi kapena mapeto a moyo wake. Akhala wansembe nthawi yonse, wofanana ndi Mwana wa Mulungu.
Ganizirrani kwambiri ukulu wake. Ngakhale Abulahamu, kholo laikulu la Israeli, anamupatsa gawo la khumi la chimene anagwira.
Tsopano malamulo a Mose amakakamiza ansembe, mbadwa za Levi, kusonkha gawo la khumi kwa Israeli onse, iwo nawo ali mbadwa za Abulahamu.
Koma Melkizedeki, amene sanali mbadwa ya Levi, analandira gawo la khumi kwa Abulahamu. Ndipo anamdalitsa Abulahamu, amene anali ndi malonjezo a Mulungu.
Ndipo palibe kukayikika kuti wamkulu amadalitsa wamng'ono.
Ansembe amene amamwalira amalandira gawo la khumi, koma pali umboni kuti Melkizedeki alikhalabe.
Ndipo tingati Levi, amene amamulandira gawo la khumi, anapereka gawo la khumi mwa Abulahamu.
Pakuti ngakhale Levi sanabadwe, anali m'thupi la Abulahamu pamene Melkizedeki anamukumana.
Choncho ngati ungwiro unafikira mwa unsembe wa Levi, umene malamulo anakhazikidwa pa iye, chifukwa chiyani zinafunikira wansembe wina, monga Melkizedeki, osati monga Aroni?
Ndipo unsembe ukasinthika, malamulo ayenera kusinthidwanso.
Pakuti wansembe amene tikunena wakhala wa fuko lina, limene mbadwa zawo sinanatumikire pa guwa la nsembe.
Pakuti ndi bwino kuti Ambuye wathu anachokera ku fuko la Yuda, ndipo Mose sanagamule unsembe wochokera ku fuko limenelo.
Ichi chidziwika bwino koposa, chifukwa wansembe wina, wofanana ndi Melkizedeki, wauluka.
Yesu anakhala wansembe, osati chifukwa cha kuyenerera mwa makhalidwe a Levi, koma mwa mphamvu ya moyo wosatheka.
Pakuti Malemba akuluza kuti, 'Iwe ndi wansembe nthawi yonse monga Melkizedeki.'
Inde, lamulo lakale pa unsembe linachotsedwa chifukwa linali lofooketsa ndi lopanda phindu.
Pakuti malamulo sanakonzetse chilichonse bwino. Koma tsopano tili ndi chiyembekezo chabwino koposa, chimene tisongerera kwa Mulungu nacho.
Dongosolo latsopano linakhazikitsidwa ndi lumbiro. Mbadwa za Aroni zinakhala ansembe wopanda lumbiro,
koma pa Yesu panalinso lumbiro. Mulungu anati, 'Yehova walumbira ndipo sadzasinthana ndi lumbiro lake: Iwe ndi wansembe nthawi yonse.'
Chifukwa cha lumbiro ili, Yesu ndiye wotsimikizira chipangano chabwino koposa.
Panali ansembe ambiri m'njira yakale, chifukwa imfa inawaletsa kupitilizira udindo.
Koma Yesu akhala nthawi yonse, choncho unsembe wake ukhala nthawi yonse.
Choncho atha kupulumutsa kwathunthu nthawi yonse iwo amene amapita kwa Mulungu mwa iye. Akhala nthawi yonse kukomba Mulungu pa ntchito yawo.
Ndiye Wansembe Wamkulu amene tifunikira, oyera ndi wopanda cholakwa, wosagwiritsidwa ndi tchimo, wapatulika ku ochimwa, natukuliridwa kupita kumwamba.

Mosiyana ndi ansembe ena, sifunikira kupereka nsembe tsiku ndi tsiku, koyamba chifukwa cha machimo ake mwini, kenaka chifukwa cha machimo a anthu. Anachita izi kamodzi chabe atadzipereka iye mwini ngati nsembe.
Malamulo anaika ansembe amene anali ndi uchifookezo wa anthu. Koma mwalonjezolo, Mulungu anaika Mwana wake amene wangwiritsidwa mpaka nthawi yonse.
Ichi ndi nkhani yaikulu: Tili ndi Wansembe Wamkulu amene anakhala ku dzanja la lamanja la mpando wa ulemerero wa Mulungu Wamkulu kumwamba.
Akutumikira m'temberero wa kumwamba, wenicheni, umene Ambuye anamanga, osati anthu.
Chifukwa Wansembe Wamkulu aliyense amayenera kupereka mphatso ndi nsembe, choncho Wansembe Wamkulu wathu ayeneranso kupereka.
Akadakhala padziko lapansi, sikanakhala wansembe, chifukwa pali ansembe amene amaperekera Mulungu mphatso zikulamuliridwa ndi malamulo.

Iwo amachita ntchito m'njira yoyimitsa ndi mthunzi wa m'temberero wa kumwamba. Pakuti Mose atakonzekera kuzika temberero, Mulungu anamuchenjeza, 'Onani kuti mupange chilichonse monga chitsanzo chimene ndakuonetsa pa phiri.'
Koma Yesu anapeza utumiki wamkulu koposa, pakuti ndi wogawana pakati pa Mulungu ndi anthu wa chipangano chabwino koposa, chimene chizikidwa pa malonjezo abwino koposa.
Ngati chipangano choyamba chinali chopanda cholakwa, panasakadakhala kufunikira kwa chipangano chachiwiri.
Koma Mulungu anaona cholakwa pa anthu, ndipo anati, 'Tsiku libwera, akuti Yehova, pamene ndidzapanga chipangano chatsopano ndi Israeli ndi Yuda.

Chipangano ichi sichidzakhala ngati chimene ndinachita ndi makolo awo tsiku ndinalanda dzanja lawo ndipo ndinawatulutsira ku Misiri. Sanakhale okhulupirika pa chipangano changa, choncho ndinawasiya, akuti Yehova.

Koma ichi ndi chipangano chimene ndidzapanga ndi Israeli pa tsiku limenelo, akuti Yehova: Ndidzaika malamulo anga m'maganizo awo, ndidzalemba pa mitima yawo. Ndidzakhala Mulungu wawo, iwo adzakhala anthu anga.
Ndipo sadzaphunzitsa anzawo kapena abale awo kuti, Muzindikire Yehova, pakuti onse adzandidziwa, kuchokera wamng'ono mpaka wamkulu.
Ndikukhululukira zolakwa zawo, ndipo sindidzakukhumbukira machimo awo.'
Mulungu ponena 'chipangano chatsopano' akusonyeza kuti chanakhalitsa chakale. Ndipo chimene chacha ndi chapweteka chidzatha posachedwa.
Chipangano choyamba chinali ndi malamulo a mpembedzo ndi malo opemphera padziko lapansi.
Panalinso zozu ziwiri m'temberero. M'chozua choyamba munali nyali, patebulo, ndi mkate wopatulika pa patebulo. Chizozu ichi chinatchulidwa Malo Oyera.
Pambuyo pa chitezo, panalinso chozua chachiwiri, chinatchulidwa Malo Oyera Koposa.

M'chozua chimenechi munali guwa la nsembe ya lubani lagolidi ndi sanduku la chipangano lozingidwa ndi golidi m'mbali zonse. M'sandukumo munali chomba cha golidi chomwe chinali mana, ndodo ya Aroni imene inaamera masamba, ndi miyala ya chipangano.
Pamwamba pa sanduku panali angelo a ulemerero wa Mulungu, miphasa yawo ikhalapo pamwamba pa malo a chifukuro. Koma sikupota kunena za izi tsopano.
Zinthu zikanali motero, ansembe amafika m'chozua choyamba tsiku ndi tsiku kuchita ntchito zawo.
Koma Wansembe Wamkulu yekha analowa m'chozua chachiwiri, kamodzi pachaka chake. Ndipo amabwereta mwazi wa nsembe chifukwa cha machimo ake mwini ndi machimo a anthu omwe anachita m'kusadziwa.
Mwa mfundo izi Mzimu Woyera akuonetsa kuti njira yolowa m'Malo Oyera Koposa inali isatseguka mpaka temberero linakaliposabe.
Ichi ndi chifanizo cha nthawi ino. Mphatso ndi nsembe zimene ansembe amaperekazi sizitha kulongosola chikumbu mtima cha obweretsa.
Pakuti dongosolo lakale limasamalira chakudya, chomwa, ndi miyambo yosiyanasiyana ya kusambitsa, malamulo a thupi okha amene anali nthawi yotsatira mpaka dongosolo labwino ladzike.
Koma Khristu anabwera ngati Wansembe Wamkulu wa zinthu zabwino zimene zafika. Analowa m'temberero wamkulu ndi wangwiro koposa, osapangidwa ndi manja a anthu, wosakhala wa chilengedwe ichi.
Mwa mwazi wake mwini, osati mwa mwazi wa mbuzi ndi ng'ombe, analowa m'Malo Oyera Koposa kamodzi chabe, nalombola chipulumutso chosatha.
Pakuti mwazi wa ng'ombe ndi mbuzi ndi phulusa ya ng'ombe wokoka anapatsa uyeru wa thupi kwa iwo odetsa.

Ganizirrani bwanji koposa mwazi wa Khristu, amene mwa mphamvu ya Mzimu wosatha anadzipereka ngati nsembe yangwiro kwa Mulungu, uyeretsa chikumbu mtima chathu ku ntchito zofa kuti tutumikire Mulungu wamoyo.

Ndiko chifukwa iye ndiye wogawana pakati pa Mulungu ndi anthu wa chipangano chatsopano, kuti iwo amene atchedwa azilandire cholowa chosatha chimene Mulungu analonjeza. Khristu anamwalira kuti awalombole ku mlandu wa machimo amene anachita pa chipangano choyamba.
Tsopano kupereka chuma pambuyo pa imfa kumafunikira umboni kuti wopereka anafa.
Chuma chimagwira mphamvu yake pambuyo pa imfa, osati mwamuna ndi moyo akalinso.
Ndiko chifukwa ngakhale chipangano choyamba chinamangidwa ndi mwazi.

Pakuti Mose atawerengera anthu malamulo onse a Mulungu, analanda mwazi wa ng'ombe ndi mbuzi pamodzi ndi madzi, nauchita mitandira ndi ubweya wofiira ndi hysopo, natcoba buku la malamulo ndi anthu onse.
Ndipo anati, 'Mwazi uwu usindikizira chipangano chimene Mulungu analonjeza kwa inu.'
Mwanjira yomweyo anatcoba mwazi m'temberero ndi pa chida chilichonse chopemphererera.
Ndipo monga mmene malamulo a Mose akuuza, chilichonse chayeretsedwa ndi mwazi. Pakuti mwazi osafikika, palibe khulukiridwa.
Ndiko chifukwa zifanizo za kumwamba zinalingana kuyeretsedwa ndi nsembe za nyama. Koma zimenizo za kumwamba zinafunikira nsembe zabwino koposa.
Pakuti Khristu sanalowe m'malo oyera opangidwa ndi anthu, zifanizo za kwenicheni. Analowa kumwamba kwenicheni, kuonekera tsopano pamaso pa Mulungu pa ntchito yathu.
Ndipo sanalowe kukadziperekatu ndi kawiri ndi kawiri, monga Wansembe Wamkulu wolowa m'Malo Oyera Koposa ndi mwazi wa nyama chaka chilichonse.
Ngati zinali motero, Khristu ayenera kufa nthawi ndi nthawi kuyambira pachiyambi pa dziko. Koma tsopano pa mapeto a nthawi yonse, anaonekera kamodzi chabe kuchotsa tchimo mwa imfa yake ngati nsembe.
Ndipo monga mmene munthu wosankha kufa kamodzi ndi pambuyo pake chiweruzo,

chimomwecho Khristu nalinso anaperekeka kamodzi chabe ngati nsembe yokhululukira machimo a ambiri. Adzabwera kachiwiri, osati kukamangana ndi machimo athu, koma kubweretsa chipulumutso kwa onse amene akumudikirira.

Dongosolo lakale la malamulo a Mose linali mthunzi wa zabwino zobwera, osati zabwino zoona. Nsembe zimenezi zimaperekedwa nthawi ndi nthawi chaka chilichonse, koma sizinakwanitse kupatulikiratu iwo amene amabwera kupembedza.
Ngati zinakwanitse, zikanakoma. Popeza iwo opembedza wakayeretsedwa kamodzi, chikumbu mtima chawo cha tchimo chikandatha.
Koma m'malo mwake, nsembe zimenezo zinakumbutsira machimo chaka chilichonse.
Pakuti mwazi wa ng'ombe ndi mbuzi sutha machimo.
Ndiko chifukwa Khristu anabwera m'dziko, anati kwa Mulungu, 'Sunasangalale ndi nsembe za nyama ndi nsembe za tchimo. Koma unandipangira thupi.
Nsembe zopsereza ndi nsembe zina za tchimo sizinakukondweretse.
Choncho ndinati, Tawonani, ndabwera kuchita chifuniro chako, Mulungu, monga inalembedwa za ine m'Malemba.'
Koyamba Khristu anati, 'Sunasangalale ndi nsembe za nyama, nsembe za tchimo, nsembe zopsereza, ndi nsembe zina za tchimo, ndipo sizinakukondweretse,' ngakhale malamulo amayitchula.
Kenaka anati, 'Tawonani, ndabwera kuchita chifuniro chako.' Achotsa chipangano choyamba kuti akhazikitse chachiwiri.
Chifuniro cha Mulungu chinali kuti tiyeretsedwe mwa nsembe ya thupi la Yesu Khristu kamodzi chabe.
Pa chipangano chakale wansembe amayima ndi kupereka nsembe zimodzi zimodzi tsiku ndi tsiku, zimene sizingathe kuchotsa machimo.
Koma Wansembe Wamkulu wathu anadzipereka kamodzi chabe ngati nsembe ya machimo, yoteteza nthawi yonse. Kenaka anakhala ku dzanja lamanja la Mulungu.
Pamenepo akuyembekezera mpaka adani ake akhale pansi pa mapazi ake.
Pakuti mwa nsembe imodzi, nakhazikitsa nthawi yonse iwo amene ayeretsedwa.
Ndipo Mzimu Woyera nalinso akutsimikiziranso. Pakuti anati,
'Ichi ndi chipangano chatsopano chimene ndidzapanga ndi anthu anga pa tsiku limenelo, akuti Yehova: Ndidzaika malamulo anga m'mitima yawo, ndidzalemba pa maganizo awo.'
Kenaka anati, 'Sindidzakukhumbukira machimo ndi mchitidwe woipa wawo.'
Ndipo machimo akakhululukidwa, palibe kufunikira kwa nsembe ina.
Choncho, akuze ndi alongo, tili ndi chilimbikitso cholowa m'Malo Oyera Koposa chifukwa cha mwazi wa Yesu.
Analowa njira yatsopano ndi yamoyo mwa chitezo, ndiyo thupi lake.
Ndipo tili ndi Wansembe Wamkulu wamkulu woyang'anira nyumba ya Mulungu.
Choncho tipite pamaso pa Mulungu ndi mitima yowona yokhulupirira kwathunthu. Chifukwa mitima yathu iyeretsedwa mwa mwazi wa Khristu ndi matupi athu asambidwa ndi madzi oyera.
Timangirire chiyembekezo chimene taululira mopanda kugonja, pakuti Mulungu amene walonjeza ndi wokhulupirika.
Tiganiziraneni mmene tidzalimbikitsane ku chikondi ndi ntchito zabwino.
Tisamasiye kusonkhana kwathu, monga momwe ena amachitira, koma tilimbikitsane, makamaka tsopano kuona kuti tsiku lake likusonjezereka.
Abwenzi, ngati tidzipitilizabe kuchimwa moganizira pambuyo pa kulandira chidziwitso cha choonadi, palibe nsembe yina ina yotiteteza ku machimo amenewo.
Pali chiyembekezo choopsa cha chiweruzo ndi moto woyaka amene udzadya adani a Mulungu.
Amene anakana malamulo a Mose anaphiwa mopanda chifundo pa umboni wa mboni ziwiri kapena zitatu.
Ganizirrani bwanji chilango chowakira iwo amene apondereza Mwana wa Mulungu, naona mwazi wa chipangano, umene unawayeretsa, ngati wamba, ndipo anachetsa Mzimu wa chisomo.
Pakuti timudziwa amene anati, 'Ine ndidzabweza. Ndidzalipirira.' Ndipo analinso, 'Yehova adzaweruza anthu ake.'
Ndi chochititsa mantha kugwa m'manja mwa Mulungu wamoyo.
Kumbukirani masiku akale ija pamene munayamba kudziwa Khristu. Munapitirira okhulupirika ngakhale munakumana ndi mazunzo aakulu.
Ena mwa nthawi mwina munaonyezedwa poyera ndikukandidzidwa, ndi ena munathandiza iwo amene anakumana ndi zinthu zomwezo.
Munazunzikira iwo adadikidwa m'ndende, ndipo chilichonse chanu chikavulidwa, munakondwa. Mukudziwa kuti muli ndi zinthu zabwino koposa zosatha.
Choncho musataye chikhulupiriro chanu cholimba. Chikubweretsa mphotho yaikulu.
Mufunikira kupirira kuti mwachita chifuniro cha Mulungu ndipo mulandire zimene Mulungu walonjeza.
'Pakuti pang'ono basi, Wobwera adzabwera osachedwa.
Ndipo wolungama wanga adzakhala ndi moyo mwa chikhulupiriro. Koma ngati atembenuka, sindidzakondwera naye.'
Koma ife si a iwo atembenukira ku chiwonongeko. Ndife a chikhulupiriro, amene miyoyo yawo apulumutsidwa.
Chikhulupiriro ndi chitsimikizo cha zinthu zimene tikukhulupirira koma sitinazone. Ndi umboni wa zinthu zimene sitinazone.
Mwa chikhulupiriro anthu akale anapeza mbiri yabwino.
Mwa chikhulupiriro tizindikira kuti chilengedwe chonse chinachitika mwa mawu a Mulungu, kotani kuti zimene zimaoneka sizinachokera ku zinthu zimaoneka.

Mwa chikhulupiriro Abele anabweretsa nsembe yoyenera koposa kwa Mulungu kuposa Kaini. Nsembe yake inaululira kulungama kwake, ndipo Mulungu anaika chizindikiro pa mphatso zake. Ngakhale Abele wafa, akunena kwa ife mwa chikhulupiriro chake mpaka tsopano.
Mwa chikhulupiriro Enoki anatengedwa kumwamba osafa. 'Anazimirira chifukwa Mulungu anamtenga.' Asanatengedwa, anadziwika kuti anamkondweretsa Mulungu.

Ndipo sikotheke kukondweretsa Mulungu wopanda chikhulupiriro. Pakuti aliyense amene akufuna kubwera kwa Mulungu ayenera kukhulupirira kuti Mulungu alipo ndi kuti amabwezera iwo amene amumfunira mwachidukulu.

Mwa chikhulupiriro Nowa anamanga ngalawa yaikulu kupulumutsa banja lake ku chigumula. Anamvera Mulungu amene anamuchenjeza za zinthu zimene sinalinze. Mwa chikhulupiriro chake anaweruza dziko lonse, nalandira kulungama kumene kumachokera mwa chikhulupiriro.
Mwa chikhulupiriro Abulahamu anamvera Mulungu atamtcha kuchoka kunyumba wake kupita ku dziko imene Mulungu anampa ngati cholowa. Anachoka, osadziwa kumene akupita.
Ngakhale atafika ku dziko limene Mulungu analonjeza, anakhala kumeneko ngati mlendo, kukhala m'matenti. Ndipo Isake ndi Yakobo nawo anali ogawana lonjezo lomwelo.
Abulahamu anayembekezera mwachilimbikitso mzinda wa maziko akhazikika, wopangidwa ndi Mulungu mwini.
Mwa chikhulupiriro Sara anakwanitsa kubereka ngakhale anali wosabereka ndipo anakalamba. Anakhulupirira kuti Mulungu adzakwaniritsa zimene analomba.
Choncho kuchoka kwa muntu mmodzi amene anali ngati wakufa, zinabadwa mbadwa ngati nyenyezi za kumwamba ndi mchenga wa mphepete mwa nyanja, wosayereka.
Anthu onsewa anamwalira m'chikhulupiriro, osalandira zimene Mulungu analonjeza. Anaona zimenezo kutali nazilandira. Analonjeza kuti anali alendo ndi achimwali pa dziko lapansi.
Anthu ananena izi kwonetsa kuti akumfunira dziko lawo.
Ngati anali akukhumba dziko limene anachoka, anali ndi mpata wobwerera.
Koma anali akufuna malo abwino koposa, dziko la kumwamba. Choncho Mulungu sachetirika kutchedwa Mulungu wawo, pakuti anawakonzera mzinda.
Mwa chikhulupiriro Abulahamu, atayesedwa, anapereka Isake ngati nsembe. Amene anali ndi malonjezo a Mulungu, anali okonzeka kupha mwana wake mmodzi.
Ngakhale Mulungu anati, 'Mwa Isake mbadwa yako idzatchulidwa.'
Abulahamu anaganiza kuti ngati Isake amwalira, Mulungu angathe kumukwezanso ku akufa. Ndipo m'njira ina, anabwerera kwa akufa.
Mwa chikhulupiriro Isake anadalitsa Yakobo ndi Esau pa zinthu zobwera.
Mwa chikhulupiriro Yakobo, akufa, anadalitsa ana awiri a Yosefe ndi kupembedza, nazetemera pa ndodo yake.
Mwa chikhulupiriro Yosefe, akufa, ananenera za kutuluka kwa Israeli ku Misiri ndipo nalamuliridwa kuchita nawo mafupa ake.
Mwa chikhulupiriro makolo a Mose anamusunga miyezi itatu atabadwa, chifukwa anaona kuti mwana anali wokongola, ndipo sanachite mantha malamulo a mfumu.
Mwa chikhulupiriro Mose, atakulirakulira, anakana kutchedwa mwana wa mwana wamkazi wa Farao.
Anasankha kuzunzana ndi anthu a Mulungu m'malo mwa kusangalala pa tchimo kwa nthawi yochepa.
Anaona kuzunzidwa chifukwa cha Khristu ngati chuma chikulu kuposa chuma cha Misiri, pakuti iye anayembekezera mphotho.
Mwa chikhulupiriro Mose anachoka Misiri, osaopa mkwiyo wa mfumu. Anapitirira kuona iye amene saoneka.
Mwa chikhulupiriro analengeza Pasika ndi kutcoba mwazi pa mazitiro kuti mngelo wopha asakhudze ana awo oyamba kubadwa.
Mwa chikhulupiriro Israeli anayenda m'Nyanja Yofiira ngati pa nthaka yowuma. Aiguluyu anafikira kugwira, nalanda.
Mwa chikhulupiriro miyanda ya Yeriko inachirikizika atazungulira masiku asanu ndi awiri.
Mwa chikhulupiriro Rahabi mhule sanawonongedwe pamodzi ndi osagwira malamulo cha mzinda wake. Anapokera anzake ochotokoza mwachifundo.
Ndinenera chiyani koposa? Nthawi ndi yopita kuuza za chikhulupiriro cha Gidiyoni, Baraki, Samsoni, Yefita, Davide, Samueli, ndi aneneri.
Mwa chikhulupiriro anthu awa anagonjetsa maufumu, natamlira molungama, nalandira zimene Mulungu walonjeza. Anatseka pakamwa pa mikango,
nazimitse moto wochitsya, napulumuka ku lupanga. Uchifookezo unasinthidwa kukhala mphamvu. Anakhala amphamvu m'nkhondo naponya asitikali.
Akazi analandiridwa ana awo ochokera m'akufa. Koma ena anazunzidwa, nakana kumasulidwa kuti apeze kuuka kobwino koposa.
Ena anasekewa ndipo amsasanira. Ena ankamangidwa m'ndende.
Ena anadulidwa miyala, enanu anasagidwa m'mapezo awiri, ndipo ena anapha ndi lupanga. Anayenda ndi zikopa za nkhosa ndi mbuzi, osauka, oponderezedwa ndi kuzunzidwa.
Dziko silinali loyenerera iwo. Anayenda m'chipululu ndi m'mapiri, namabisama m'mapanga ndi m'maburi a nthaka.
Anthu onsewa anapeza mbiri yabwino mwa chikhulupiriro, koma sanapeze zimene Mulungu analonjeza.
Pakuti Mulungu anasankha chinthu chabwino koposa kwa ife, kuti iwo pasopano ndi ife pamodzi akhale angwiro.

Choncho, popeza tazingidwa ndi anthu ambiri ochita umboni wa chikhulupiriro, tivule zilembo zonse ndi tchimo limene limatisakamula mosavuta. Tithamange ndi kupirira mpikisano umene wakonzedwa kwa ife.

Tiyang'anire Yesu, woyambira ndi wangwiritsira chikhulupiriro chathu. Chifukwa cha chimwemwe chimene chinalindirira, ananyamula mtanda, naona manyazi ngati chabe. Ndipo tsopano anakhala ku dzanja lamanja la mpando wa Mulungu.
Ganizirrani za mikangano imene anayumva kwa ochimwa, ndipo simudzafooketse kapena kulephera.
Mukumenyera nkhondo ndi tchimo, koma simunafikire kukhetsa mwazi wanu.
Ndipo mwawala mauthenga aulimbikitso amene Mulungu anauza inu monga ana ake? Anati, 'Mwana wanga, usafunde chilango cha Yehova, ndipo usataye mtima akukulangiza.
Pakuti Yehova amalanga iwo amene amakonda, ndipo amachitsitsa aliyense amene amulandira ngati mwana.'
Piririrani chilango ichi monga kuphunzitsidwa kwa ana. Pakuti Mulungu akuzipereka kwa inu monga ana ake. Ndani waona mwana amene bambo ake samlanga?
Ngati Mulungu sakulangani monga ana ake onse, ndiye kuti ndinu ana akuba, osati ana enieni.
Poikira kuti abambo athu a padziko lapansi analanga, tinawachilila. Sitidzagonjera koposa Atate wa mizimu yathu, namukhala ndi moyo?
Abambo athu anatipatsa chilango kwa nthawi yochepa monga mmene ankaona koyenera. Koma chilango cha Mulungu chimakukondwera, kuti tigawane uyeru wake.
Chilango chonse sichimasangalatsa pa nthawi imene imachitika — chimapweteka! Koma pambuyo pake chimabweretsa zipatso zachimphu za kulungama kwa iwo ophunzitsidwa nacho.
Choncho kwezani manja anu otopa ndi mawondo anu ofooketsa.
Longosozani njira yowongoka pa mapazi anu kuti ofooka ndi olumala asagwe koma akulire.
Yesani kukhala m'mtendere ndi aliyense, ndi kukhala oyera, chifukwa opanda uyeru sadzaona Ambuye.
Samaliranani kuti wina mwa inu asamise chisomo cha Mulungu. Onani kuti muzu woyipatsa uchungu usamere usokeze ambiri.
Onani kuti palibe wachitchirerwa kapena wopanda Mulungu monga Esau, amene anagulitsa mfundo yake yokhalanso woyamba kubadwa pa chakudya chimodzi.
Mukudziwa kuti pambuyo pake, akhumba kulandira mdalitso wa abambo ake, anakandidwa. Sanapeze mpata wa kutembenuka mtima, ngakhale analomba ndi misozi.
Simubwera ku phiri lokhudza, la moto woyaka, mdima, chikosi, ndi mphepo yamkuntho, monga Israeli anachita ku Phiri la Sinai.
Anabva lipenga lodabwitsa ndi mawu, ndipo iwo amene anamva anakhomba Mulungu alalike.
Chifukwa sanakwanitsa kuyumvira lamulo, 'Ngakhale nyama ingakhudze phiri, idulidwe miyala.'
Mose mwini anachita mantha kwambiri kotani kuti anati, 'Ndichita mantha ndipo ndikunjenjemera.'
Ai, mwabwera ku Phiri la Ziyoni, ku mzinda wa Mulungu wamoyo, Yerusalemu la kumwamba, ndi gulu la angelo opanda chiwerengero m'kusangalala kwawo.
Mwabwera ku mpingo wa ana oyamba kubadwa a Mulungu, amene mayina awo alembedwa kumwamba. Mwabwera kwa Mulungu amene ndi Mweruzi wa aliyense. Mwabwera kwa mizimu ya olungama amene angwiritsidwa.
Mwabwera kwa Yesu, wogawana pakati pa chipangano chatsopano, ndi mwazi wotchokedwa, amene umayankhula za chikhululukiro m'malo mwa kufuna ubwezero ngati mwazi wa Abele.

Samalirani kuti musana mauthenga a Mulungu amene akunena. Ngati Israeli sanakwanitsike kuthawa pamene anakana Mose, wotumizidwa wa padziko lapansi, tidzakwanitsike bwanji ife ngati tichoka kwa iye amene akunena kuchoka kumwamba?
Pa nthawi imeneyo mawu ake anagwedetsa dziko, koma tsopano walonjeza, 'Ndidzagwetsa dziko ndi kumwamba kamodzinso.'
Ichi kusonyeza kuti chilengedwe chonse chigwetsedwa ndi kuchotsedwa kuti zosagwetseka chabe zikhale.
Choncho popeza talandira ufumu wosagwetseka, tiyamike Mulungu, ndipo tipembedze iye m'mantha ndi kulemekezeka.
Pakuti Mulungu wathu ndi moto wophya.
Pitirizani kukondana monga abale.
Musaiwale kupokera alendo, chifukwa pa kuchita ichi, ena anapokera angelo osadziwa.
Kumbukirani iwo amene ali m'ndende ngati muli ndi iwo. Kumbukirani iwo amene amaponderezedwa, ngati inu mwini mukumva ululu m'matupi anu.
Lemekezetsa ukwati, ndipo akamuna ndi akazi akhale okhulupirika m'ukwati. Pakuti Mulungu adzaweruza achitchirerwa ndi achigololo.
Musakonde ndalama; kondwererani ndi zimene muli nazo. Pakuti Mulungu anati, 'Sindidzakusiyani kapena kukuchokerani.'
Motero tingathe kulankhula mwachilimbikitso, 'Yehova ndi mthandizi wanga, choncho sindiopa. Anthu angandithandize chiyani?'
Kumbukirani atsogoleri anu amene anakuphunzitsani Mawu a Mulungu. Ganizirrani mapeto a moyo wawo ndi kutsata chikhulupiriro chawo.
Yesu Khristu ndi wokhalabe, dzulo, lero, ndi nthawi yonse.
Choncho musapusitsidwe ndi maphunziro achilendo. Kukhalira kwanu kumachokera kwa chisomo cha Mulungu, osati ku malamulo a chakudya, amene sanathandize amene anatsatira.
Tili ndi guwa la nsembe imene ansembe a m'temberero alibe ufulu kudya.
Pa chipangano chakale Wansembe Wamkulu amapereka mwazi wa nyama m'Malo Oyera Koposa ngati nsembe ya tchimo, ndipo matupi a nyama apsyedwa kunja kwa msasa.
Chimomwecho Yesu anamwalira kunja kwa chipata cha mzinda kuti ayeretse anthu ake mwa mwazi wake.
Choncho tipite kwa iye kunja kwa msasa ndi kumnyamula manyazi amene iye anyamula.
Pakuti dziko ino si dziko lathu lokhalamo kwanthawi; tikuyembekezera dziko lobwera.
Choncho mwa Yesu, nthawi yonse tipereke nsembe ya matamando kwa Mulungu, ndiyo zipatso za milomo imene imalalikira dzina lake.
Ndipo musaiwale kuchita zabwino ndi kugawana ndi ena. Nsembe zimenezi zimakondweretsa Mulungu.

Mvera atsogoleri anu ndi kuwagonjera. Ntchito yawo ndi kuyang'anira miyoyo yanu, ndipo adzapereka nkhani kwa Mulungu. Awasangalatseni kuchita ntchito yawo ndi chimwemwe, osati chisoni. Kuchita chosoni iye sikukupindulira.
Pemphereraninso ife, pakuti chikumbu mtima chathu ndi chowona ndipo tifuna kukhala ndi khalidwe labwino m'chilichonse.
Makamaka ndikupempha kuti pemphererani kuti ndidzabweranso kwa inu posachedwa.
Tsopano Mulungu wa mtendere, amene anaukitsa Ambuye wathu Yesu, mnyamula wa nkhosa wamkulu, kuchoka m'akufa mwa mwazi wa chipangano chosatha,
akukonzeni ndi chilichonse chabwino kuchita chifuniro chake. Ndipo achite mwa inu chimene chimamukondweretsa mwa mphamvu ya Yesu Khristu. Ulemerero wake ukhale nthawi yonse ndi nthawi yonse! Ameni.
Ndikukomba, akuze ndi alongo, mverani mauthenga achifupi a kalata ino.
Ndifuna mudziwe kuti m'bale wathu Timoteo wamasulidwa m'ndende. Ngati adzabwere msanga, ndidzabwera ndi iye kukaonana ndi inu.
Perekezani moni kwa atsogoleri anu onse ndi okhulupirira onse. Okhulupirira a Italia akukuperekezani moni.
Chisomo cha Mulungu chikhale ndi inu nonse.
